predecessors.name: Duchy of Milan
predecessors.text: the Visconti duchy at Filippo Maria's death on 13 August 1447, less Pavia, Lodi and Piacenza

successors.name: Duchy of Milan
successors.text: Sforza's duchy: 'On 22 March 1450, he had himself declared capitano del popolo' and Duke of Milan by right of his wife

ledger.x: Page silent on the date: Pavia declares itself independent and falls to Sforza.
Page silent on the date: Lodi and Piacenza defect and Venice occupies them.
1447: Filippo Maria Visconti dies and Milan proclaims a republic.
1450: Francesco Sforza takes Milan and the republic ends.

wars.name: War of the Ambrosian Republic against Sforza and Venice
wars.outcome: The republic hired Sforza, who defected to Venice (treaty of 18 October 1448); Venice was beaten at Caravaggio in 1448 (the page: Attendolo attacked 'until 15 September'), the peace with Venice of 1449 was signed behind Sforza's back, the coup of 24 February…

certainty.note: The republic's real extent is unknown: the page names only Pavia, Lodi, Piacenza, Tortona and Crema as lost or contested, with no dates and no boundary.
